jobs.name: v1
lines: Look at this triangle. Four pieces.
Now I move the same four pieces around.
Wait... there's a hole! Where did the square go?
Here's the secret. It was never a real triangle.
The red slope is three over eight. The blue slope is two over five. They are different!
So the long side is bent?
Exactly. That tiny bend hides one whole square. Did you spot it?
